research_question: Can exact H2-triggered action counterfactuals distilled into only the actor head improve TH05 Lunatic Stage 1 under a strict no-miss, no-bomb contract?

invalidated_collection.reason: Trajectory navigation enabled the native deathbomb guard. Branches themselves excluded bombs, but their recurrent histories were not NMNB-clean.
invalidated_collection.action: Moved aside and excluded before any formal split or training.

counterfactual_collection.trajectory_navigation: seeded categorical source policy under H6, with bomb action masked
counterfactual_collection.continuation: deterministic source actor under H6, no bombs
counterfactual_collection.retention_rule: Keep an anchor only when every legal movement branch completes and at least one action collides while at least one action survives the horizon.

x11_isolation.reason: Concurrent DOSBox-X save hotkeys on one DISPLAY caused a save archive timeout despite private save files.
x11_isolation.parallelism_policy: Serialize exact branching per private DISPLAY; parallelize ordinary live evaluation instead.

actor_distillation.risk_target: binary exact collision or pending-hit outcome for each legal movement action
actor_distillation.selection_rule: Minimize the risk-adjusted distillation objective on complete selection trajectories, including epoch 0 as a candidate.

full_stage_heldout_diagnostic.interpretation: The experimental student has higher mean return and median survival, but slightly lower mean survival, identical game-over/miss counts, and no clear. Held-out data do not override the prior source selection.

conclusion: The grouped exact-branching and actor-only deployment pipeline is operational under a verified NMNB action contract, but this first 18-anchor training split does not generalize. Every non-zero epoch loses to the source on selection objective; the diagnostic epoch also worsens held-out causal risk. Both source and student obtain 0/8 held-out Stage 1 clears and exactly 24 misses. Retain the source and reject the actor update.
next_experiment: Increase stage-stratified counterfactual coverage and train a richer offline action-risk teacher over frozen recurrent features before distillation. Test whether the source latent state linearly separates safe actions; if not, permit offline encoder/GRU adaptation with a strict behavior trust region while keeping the deployed architecture and NMNB mask unchanged.
